# Referencias

- https://doi.org/10.1016/J.DIB.2024.110079

# Librerias y configuración

```{r}
#| label: setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```

# Importación de datos

> url: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xFIuUjLF1F2XDSoYLDKs-SBmSDECIopNJAcabvkdlEw/edit?gid=1125441718#gid=1125441718

```{r}
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xFIuUjLF1F2XDSoYLDKs-SBmSDECIopNJAcabvkdlEw/edit?gid=1125441718#gid=1125441718"

gs <- as_sheets_id(url)

datos <- range_read(ss = gs, sheet = "Table1")

datos <- datos %>%
  rename_all(~str_replace_all(., " ", "_"))


str(datos)
``` 

# Limpieza de datos

```{r}
datos <- datos %>%
  filter(!is.na(Accessions_Code))
```

# Conversión de variables cualitativas
```{r}
qualitative_vars <- c(
  "Flower_Type",
  "Number_of_Leaves",
  "Leaf_Shape",
  "Flower_Color",
  "Seed_Color",
  "Seed_Shape"
)

datos <- datos %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(qualitative_vars),
      as.factor
    )
  )
str(datos)
```

# Promedio por accesión

```{r}
datos_mean <- datos %>%
  group_by(Accessions_Code) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric) & !any_of("Replication"),
      mean,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


str(datos_mean)
```

# Preparación de matriz para PCA

```{r}
accession <- datos_mean$Accessions_Code

pca_data <- datos_mean %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Plant_Height_(cm),
    Leaf_Length_(cm),
    Leaf_Width_(cm),
    Flowering_Age_(DAP),
    Flower_Length_(cm),
    Flower_Width_(cm),
    Weight_of_1_Fresh_Flower_(g),
    Calix_Length_(cm),
    Weight_of_Fresh_Flower_per_Plant__(g),
    Weight_of_Total_Fresh_Flower_(g),
    Pod_Length__(cm),
    Pod_Width_(mm),
    Number_of_Pods_per_Plant,
    Weight_of_Pods_per_Plant_(g),
    Number_of_Total_Pods,
    Weight_of_Total_Pods_(g),
    Seed_Length_(mm),
    Seed_Width_(mm),
    Seed_Diameter_(mm),
    Number_of_Seed_per_Pod,
    Weight_of_Seed_per_Plant_(g),
    Weight_of_Total_Seed_(g),
    Weight_of_100_Seed_(g)
  )

```

# Selección de variables cuantitativas

```{r}
pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_data)


rownames(pca_data) <- accession


head(pca_data)
```

# PCA

```{r}
mv <- PCA(
  X = pca_data,
  scale.unit = TRUE,
  graph = FALSE
)

summary(
  mv,
  nbelements = Inf,
  nb.dec = 2
)

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca_var(mv)

pcainfo$cor

pcainfo$contrib
```

# Selección de variables cuantitativas

```{r}
var <- plot.PCA(
  mv,
  choix="var",
  cex=0.7
)


ind <- plot.PCA(
  mv,
  choix="ind",
  label="ind",
  cex=0.7
)

list(var, ind) %>%
plot_grid(
  plotlist = .,
  ncol = 2,
  labels = "auto"
)
```

# HCA

```{r}
cls <- HCPC(
  mv,
  graph = FALSE
)

plot.HCPC(
  cls,
  choice = "map",
  nb.clust = 2,
  draw.tree = FALSE
)


plot.HCPC(
  cls,
  choice="tree",
  nb.clust=2,
  draw.tree=FALSE
)
```
